patch_description: Extends the current greedy + move/swap local search with a third move type: 3-cycle rotation of models across the two hottest GPUs. When moves and pairwise swaps fail, try relocating model A from the hottest GPU to the second-hottest, model B from the second-hottest back to the hottest, plus a third model C rotating from second-hottest to hottest (or via a third GPU), accepting only strict improvements guarded by epsilon. This escapes local optima that 2-model swaps cannot, further minimizing the maximum KVPR while preserving feasibility (memory-fit checks) and termination (strict-improvement guard).
